Our latest São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence, houses our Quant, Front Office & Risk Technology Services (FORTS) & Murex teams. The São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence was opened with the goal to strengthened Phi's current relationship with our North America clients, as well with global clients with presence in São Paulo. Joining us means diving into truly groundbreaking work, pushing the limits of what modern technology can deliver while solving high-impact challenges for top-tier clients. You’ll build cutting-edge solutions for the world’s largest Investment Banks, leading Asset Managers, and market-defining Hedge Funds, working on projects where innovation is not an extra, but a fundamental expectation in everything we deliver.

About The FORTS Practice

Phi Partners is one of the largest consultancies specializing FORTS, with a dedicated team of over 175 consultants spread across multiple locations. Our team is distinguished by deep expertise in front-office and risk technology solutions, empowering top-tier financial institutions to optimize their trading and risk management capabilities.

At Phi Partners, we are committed to a collaborative, high-performance culture where professionals work together to deliver complex front-office solutions to elite clients. We specialize in the end-to-end implementation of front-office and risk platforms, from initial requirements gathering to post-go-live support, ensuring that our clients are fully supported throughout the platform lifecycle. We focus on custom development and configuration, creating solutions that address unique client needs and regulatory requirements in real-time trading and risk management.

Additionally, we conduct extensive training and knowledge transfer sessions, ensuring client teams are equipped to maximize the value of their technology investments.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop robust, scalable applications supporting E-Trading systems across asset classes

• Apply sound design and architecture principles, using data structures and algorithms for performance

• Stay current with technologies and industry trends, particularly within algorithmic and e-Trading platforms

The Ideal candidate

• Hands-on experience with Java - including experience in electronic trading platforms

• Experience with unit testing and CI/CD pipelines

• Knowledge on one of the following: Equities; FX; Rates; Credit; and Derivatives is a plus

• In-depth knowledge of multithreading, memory management, and low-latency systems

Why should you join Phi Parnters

Join us as we build the next-generation eTrading team, an ambitious, fast-growing group delivering world-class, complex, and genuinely exciting projects to major financial institutions around the globe. We’re in a pivotal expansion phase, working with leading-edge technologies and giving you the chance to shape our strategy, influence key architectural decisions, and deploy solutions that truly impact global Capital Markets. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a world-leading Capital Markets Technology Consultancy while working alongside one of the strongest banking organizations in the industry.

title: Senior Instrumentation Engineer - (Relocation to Saudi Arabia is required)
description:
Role : Senior Instrumentation Engineer

Job Description:

We are seeking an Instrumentation Engineer with extensive experience in Instrumentation utilized for the final control, monitoring and safety of Gas Plants, NGL Fractionation Plants, Refineries, petrochemicals plants, Pipelines and Distribution facilities, to join the Process Automation and Systems Division, which is part of the Process & Control Systems Department.

Process and Control Systems Department provides services in the field of process engineering, automation, new energy, and digitalization to various entities within Aramco.

As an Instrumentation Engineer your primary role will be to provide instrumentation engineering expertise to the various Aramco entities including designing, developing, installing, and troubleshooting. You will work with different disciplines such as operating sites, instrumentation engineering, facility planning, and project management. Additionally, you are expected to participate in the organization and company initiatives including safety programs, innovation programs, operational excellence, knowledge sharing, self-development and other programs as required.

Key Responsibilities:

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide support with all types of instrumentation including but not limited level, temperature, pressure, control valves, Emergency Isolation Valves, Motor Operated Valve, Relief Valves, flow measurement, level gauges etc.
  • Originate and carries out engineering studies to determine optimal solutions to complex technical problems, increase revenue, reduce cost, and improve process safety.
  • Works with and/or leads Task teams assigned to investigate incidents or solve specific technical problems.
  • Undertakes special assignments requiring extensive technical experience and discretion when dealing with outside organizations.
  • Develops and maintains Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards, Material Specifications, Procedures and Best Practices to enhance company profitability, safety, and productivity by applying and interpreting key industry codes and standards relevant to instrumentation and control.
  • Reviews and evaluates capabilities of vendors and contractors to determine their acceptability to perform major services to Saudi Aramco.
  • Acts as a Company representative in technical dealings with vendors, manufacturers, and design firms.
  • Perform technical evaluation for instrumentation quotations and attend technical bid evaluation meetings.
  • Evaluates and introduces best practices and new technologies to enable the Company to achieve Best in Class performance in oil and gas business.
  • Performs cost analyses and Value Engineering studies to recommend cost-effective solutions to technical issues.

Minimum Requirements:

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering preferably in Instrumentation, Mechanical or Electrical engineering. A Master's degree or PhD in Engineering is desired but not required.
  • Minimum 20 years of professional experience as an engineer in charge of technical work in field of specialty. Previous work with a major international Oil & Gas Company and/or previous employment with one of the Instrumentation suppliers used by Company is desired.
  • Must have experience in plant instrumentation sizing and selection (Control valves, Pressure Relief valves, Actuators, Basic Process Measurement etc.)
  • Certified in ISA- Certified Automation Professional (CAP), Certified Functional Safety Professional (CFSP), TUV FSEng, Principles & Practice of Engineering (PE) certification, or Chartered Engineer (C.E.) license or registration.
  • Basic knowledge of H2S, LEL, pH, conductivity, O2 analyzer, CO/CO2 analyzer, fire & gas detectors and Gas chromatographs is preferred.
  • Proficiency in the International codes and standards used within the oil and gas industry, i.e., API, BS, ISO, ASME, ANSI, IEC, ISA, IEEE, etc.
  • Have participated as lead engineer in HAZOP, SIL, P&ID, Design, and model reviews.
  • Understanding of control systems, compressor and pumps field instrumentation, speed controllers, Vibration Monitoring Systems (VMS), Compressor Control Systems (CCS).
  • Understanding communication protocols like DNP3, Modbus, FieldBus, TCP, IEC, SPA, RP570, ANSI and General Process Automation Protocols.
  • Have been an active member in a relevant professional society, (i.e., ISA, IEEE, etc.) for a minimum of 3 years and have been holding current membership.

title: Analista de BI e Integrações de Dados Pl. / Sr.
description:
Quem somos 

Somos uma agência especializada em campanhas de incentivo e programas de fidelização. Transformamos dados em ação para engajar vendedores, distribuidoras e consumidores em todo o Brasil. Valorizamos colaboração, autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e foco em resultados. 

Descrição da vaga 

Como Analista de BI, você será a pessoa responsável por transformar dados em conhecimento estratégico, garantindo que cada projeto disponha de informações confiáveis, atualizadas e fáceis de interpretar. Sua missão vai desde a arquitetura dos fluxos de dados até a entrega de análises que orientem decisões, mensurem desempenho e potencializem resultados. 

MÍNIMO COMPROVADO DE 5 ANOS NA ÁREA

Principais responsabilidades 

● Coletar, análise, organizar e higienizar dados vindos de SQL Server, PostgreSQL, APIs e arquivos (CSV/Excel). 

● Migrar e evoluir nossos painéis de BI (Power BI) preservando histórico e métricas-chave de campanhas de incentivo. 

● Automatizar relatórios de auditoria e acompanhar KPIs de qualidade de dados (completeness, accuracy, timeliness). 

● Aplicar análises exploratórias e modelos preditivos que revelem oportunidades para impulsionar engajamento e performance das campanhas. 

● Trabalhar lado a lado com squads de Marketing, Produto e Tecnologia, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em dashboards, alertas ou APIs de dados . 

● Documentar processos, compartilhar conhecimento e cultivar um ambiente colaborativo . 

● Desenvolvimento de rotinas automatizadas para sincronização de dados entre diferentes plataformas; 

Requisitos obrigatórios 

● Perfil analítico e consultivo 

● Power BI avançado (DAX, Power Query, publicação e gateways). 

● SQL sólido em SQL Server e PostgreSQL (criação de views, stored procedures, tuning). 

● ETL (Extração, Transformação e Carga) Integração de Dados : Capacidade de extrair dados de diferentes fontes (bancos de dados, arquivos CSV, APIs, etc.), transformá-los em um formato adequado e carregá-los no Power BI. 

● Habilidades em Python e outras linguagens de análise de dados. 

● Uso do Power Query: Habilidade em utilizar o Power Query para realizar transformações de dados, como limpeza, filtragem e agregação. 

● Perfil proativo, prestativo e orientado a resultados , com capacidade de comunicar insights a públicos não técnicos.

● Vivência na construção e manutenção de KPIs, relatórios e dashboards. 

● Excelente comunicação para apresentar insights a stakeholders não técnicos. 

Diferenciais que contam ponto 

● Uso prático do n8n para automatização de processos e integrações. 

● Experiência em BI voltado a campanhas de incentivo (lifecycle, cohort, ROI de promoções). 

● Certificações Microsoft (Power BI Data Analyst, Azure Data Engineer) ou equivalentes. 

Por que se juntar a nós? 

● Ambiente colaborativo, com autonomia para propor e testar novas soluções. 

● Projetos de alto impacto nacional, com dados reais de milhões de interações. 

● Cultura de aprendizado contínuo.

description:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. The SAP AMS Project Manager is responsible for managing the delivery of SAP Application Management Services across multiple modules and business areas. Strong knowledge of SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, etc.) and integration points.

Experience with ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Release Management).

PMP, ITIL, or SAP certifications (SAP Solution Manager, Activate, S/4HANA) preferred.

Deep understanding of SAP AMS operating model.

Strong leadership and team coordination skills.

Analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making ability.

Customer-first mindset with service excellence orientation.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Superior completo em Direito;

title: Business Development Consultant - Robotics & Automation
description:
Company Description

Founded in 2002, AMS Inc. (Advanced Mechatronics Solutions, Inc.) has grown into a diverse global enterprise dedicated to delivering top-tier factory automation solutions. Committed to professionalism and exceptional customer service, AMS specializes in designing and manufacturing state-of-the-art automation equipment. The company integrates cutting-edge technologies and focuses on continuous innovation to ensure high performance and precision. With a mission to meet customer needs, AMS has established itself as a leader in advanced mechatronic solutions worldwide.

Role Description

The AMR & Robotic Sales Engineer will play a critical role in managing customer relationships, providing technical support, and driving sales of advanced mechatronics and robotic solutions. This role involves tasks such as identifying customer needs, crafting tailored automation solutions, delivering product presentations, and providing pre-sales and post-sales support. Coordinating with internal teams to ensure successful project execution is also a key responsibility. This is a hybrid contract role based in São Paulo, SP, with opportunities for remote work.

This role is focused on identifying new business opportunities for our AMR (Autonomous Mobile Robots) and COBOT (Collaborative Robots) solutions within the automotive, electronics, and logistics sectors. You will act as a strategic partner, bridge the gap between technical possibilities and client needs, and build a robust sales pipeline in South America’s largest industrial hub.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead Generation: Identify and engage with key decision-makers (Plant Managers, Engineering Directors) in the Greater São Paulo area and nearby industrial clusters.
  • Solution Selling: Analyze client production lines to propose optimized AMR and COBOT integration strategies.
  • Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term partnerships with Tier 1/Tier 2 automotive suppliers and large-scale manufacturing facilities.
  • Project Oversight: Coordinate with the global technical team to provide accurate quotations and manage the local contract process.
  • Market Intelligence: Provide regular reports on Brazilian market trends, competitor activities, and local regulatory requirements.
Qualifications:
  • Experience: Minimum 3–7 years of proven experience in technical sales, specifically within industrial automation, robotics, or heavy machinery.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of Industry 4.0 , AMR navigation (SLAM), and COBOT applications.
  • Local Network: A strong existing portfolio of contacts within the Brazilian manufacturing industry (especially in the ABC region of São Paulo).
  • Languages: Native proficiency in Portuguese is mandatory. Fluency in English (or Spanish) is required for seamless communication with our global offices in the US and Mexico.
  • Technical Background: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Automation Engineering (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Mindset: A proactive, "hunter" mentality with the ability to work independently as a contractor and drive results with minimal supervision.

title: Analista Tributário Pleno
description:
O Analista Tributário Pleno é responsável por garantir a correta apuração, recolhimento e conformidade dos tributos da empresa, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação tributária vigente e mitigando riscos fiscais. Atua de forma analítica e consultiva, apoiando as áreas internas, elaborando obrigações acessórias, acompanhando fiscalizações e prestando suporte técnico em temas tributários.

Apuração e Conformidade Tributária

  • Apurar e conferir o recolhimento de todos os impostos, taxas e contribuições, assegurando a acuracidade dos valores e o atendimento à legislação brasileira vigente.
  • Orientar as áreas da empresa quanto ao cálculo, retenção e recolhimento adequado dos impostos devidos.
  • Atualizar-se continuamente quanto às alterações na legislação fiscal federal, estadual e municipal.
  • Entender o vínculo entre receitas e custos, utilizando essa informação para orientar o foco econômico.

Obrigações Acessórias e Reportes

  • Elaborar informações mensais e anuais para os órgãos federais, estaduais e municipais, incluindo obrigações acessórias.
  • Aferir e ratificar a correta elaboração e entrega das obrigações acessórias (anuais, semestrais e mensais), evitando penalidades.

Análise Fiscal e Regularização de Pendências

  • Analisar e regularizar possíveis pendências identificadas nas composições dos saldos das contas de impostos.
  • Acompanhar a situação fiscal das empresas do grupo junto a órgãos federais, estaduais, municipais e autarquias, providenciando a regularização quando necessário.

Pareceres Técnicos e Suporte Jurídico

  • Emitir pareceres sobre assuntos fiscais e tributários, especialmente relacionados à retenção de impostos.
  • Elaborar defesas administrativas e acompanhar processos tributários, prestando suporte aos advogados responsáveis.

Relacionamento Institucional

  • Manter contato direto com representantes de órgãos públicos, autarquias e entidades afins.

Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos nas áreas Fiscal, Contábil ou Controladoria.
  • Conhecimento sólido da legislação tributária brasileira.
  • Desejavel Inglês avançado ou Espanhol.

Competências Esperadas

  • Visão estratégica e entendimento do negócio.
  • Forte orientação a resultados.
  • Capacidade analítica e senso crítico.
  • Boa comunicação, influência e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade a diferentes cenários.

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, Respond.io is a pioneering Business Messaging platform that seamlessly unifies customer communication across instant messaging, web chat, and email. At Respond.io , we are not just a platform—we are a movement, pushing the boundaries of customer communication for tech-savvy organizations worldwide. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of business messaging!

Our Culture

At respond.io , we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!

Role Description

Respond.io is expanding rapidly, aiming for a $1 billion valuation following our successful Series A funding. We seek a visionary Partnerships Manager to nurture and support our channel partner ecosystem. The ideal candidate will drive mutual success through strong relationship management, strategic collaboration, and effective enablement.

Responsibilities

  • Identify potential channel partners that align with the company's strategic goals.
  • Develop and execute recruitment strategies to onboard new partners.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing channel partners.
  • Act as the main point of contact for partners, addressing their needs and concerns.
  • Organize regular meetings, business reviews, and performance assessments with partners.
  • Develop and deliver training programs to educate partners on the company's products, services, and sales processes.
  • Provide ongoing support and resources to partners to ensure their success.
  • Collaborate with partners to develop and execute joint business plans to drive sales and market penetration.
  • Monitor and analyze partner performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
  • Achieve sales targets and revenue goals through effective partner management.
  • Gather market insights and feedback from partners to improve product development and strategy.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities, and market dynamics.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in channel management, partner-led sales and business development experience.
  • Experienced in Channel/Sales in a SaaS based company
  • Proven track record of successfully managing and growing channel partner relationships.
  • Experienced in building business and marketing plans with Partners.
  • Well-organized, proactive, goal-oriented, and able to prioritize.
  • Ability to operate both at a strategic and hands-on level.
  • Good communication skills in English with an ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing.
  • Nimble and agile team player with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced start-up environment.

Here's what's in for you

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like talent shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!

title: Engenheiro mecânico (PJ)
description:
Mechanical Engineering (PJ)

Looking for:

We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join our team. This position

will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and

bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling,

prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all

requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer Reporting to the Staff (USA), Engineer out of Campinas.

The Candidate:

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the

concept to manufacturing journey. You’ve either built or supported bringing new products to the

world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of

materials. You’re willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on

challenges.

The Qualifications :

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE’s.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • Ability to work in English

The Job:

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

The Responsibilities:

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.e. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components.
  • Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. title: E-Commerce Marketing Manager
description:
E-Commerce Marketing Manager

Part-time | Remote

Mindshare Data & Analytics

Our Vision

At Mindshare Data & Analytics, we believe the future of commerce is shaped by intelligence, not assumption. We exist to help brands navigate complexity—using data not merely as a reporting tool, but as a foundation for clarity, confidence, and sustainable growth.

Our long-term vision is to redefine how e-commerce strategies are built and scaled through rigorous analytics, human insight, and responsible decision-making. What sets Mindshare apart is our commitment to thoughtful execution, our respect for collaboration, and our belief that meaningful outcomes are achieved when data serves both business goals and human understanding.

As digital commerce continues to evolve, we are expanding our leadership team with individuals who value depth, precision, and long-term impact.

Why This Role Is Essential

The E-Commerce Marketing Manager plays a critical role in shaping how brands grow in increasingly competitive digital marketplaces. This position sits at the intersection of strategy, performance, and insight—transforming data into actions that drive sustainable commercial results.

Your work will directly influence how clients approach customer acquisition, conversion, and retention across e-commerce platforms. More importantly, this role contributes to the evolution of Mindshare’s data-led commerce framework, ensuring our strategies remain intelligent, adaptable, and future-focused.

This is a part-time, fully remote role, offering flexibility alongside meaningful strategic responsibility.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and oversee e-commerce marketing strategies aligned with client business objectives
  • Analyze performance data across digital commerce channels to identify trends and growth opportunities
  • Optimize campaigns across the customer journey, from acquisition to conversion and retention
  • Translate complex datasets into clear insights and actionable recommendations
  • Collaborate with analytics, media, and strategy teams to ensure cohesive execution
  • Continuously refine strategies based on testing, learning, and evolving market dynamics
Required Skills & Qualifications
  • Proven experience in e-commerce marketing or digital commerce strategy
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret data thoughtfully and accurately
  • Strategic mindset combined with practical execution skills
  • Clear, professional communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • High attention to detail, accountability, and intellectual curiosity
  • Ability to work independently while contributing meaningfully within a remote team
Preferred Experience (Valued, Not Required)
  • Experience working with data-driven or performance-focused organizations
  • Familiarity with analytics platforms, attribution models, or e-commerce ecosystems
  • Exposure to international markets or multi-channel commerce strategies
  • Experience collaborating within cross-functional or distributed teams

We value thoughtful professionals who bring perspective, humility, and a commitment to continuous learning.

Our Culture & What We Offer
  • Part-time, remote flexibility , designed to support balance and sustainable performance
  • A respectful, trust-based environment where expertise is recognized and encouraged
  • Opportunities to work on meaningful e-commerce challenges with real business impact
  • Collaboration with experienced strategists, analysts, and digital specialists
  • A culture rooted in clarity, integrity, and shared success

At Mindshare, we believe strong outcomes are built through trust, thoughtful dialogue, and shared purpose.

A Personal Invitation

If you are an e-commerce professional who values insight over assumption and strategy over shortcuts, we invite you to consider this opportunity. This role is designed for individuals who see commerce not just as transactions, but as relationships shaped by intelligence and care.

  • Your experience and perspective could help define what comes next.

title: Analista de Dados I
description:
Analista de Dados I

Belo Horizonte/MG

#VemSerOC

Pioneira no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, a Oncoclínicas&Co foi fundada em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.

Na essência da Oncoclínicas&Co , o paciente é o centro de tudo. É para ele que buscamos os mais avançados tratamentos e o mais alto nível de qualidade e segurança. Temos como pilares de atuação o acolhimento e a inovação no tratamento oncológico e a atenção integral e personalizada, com um olhar no indivíduo.

Aqui na Oncoclínicas&Co valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.

O que você irá fazer:

  • Identificar e compreender os objetivos da análise de dados;
  • Analisar as necessidades e requisitos da empresa em relação aos dados;
  • Extrair dados relevantes de diversas fontes, como bancos de dados e planilhas;
  • Realizar a limpeza e pré-processamento dos dados para garantir qualidade e integridade;
  • Utilizar técnicas adequadas para preparar os dados para análise;
  • Empregar ferramentas como linguagens de programação, bancos de dados e software estatístico para realizar a análise;
  • Analisar e submeter documentos dos times jurídico e regulatório para apoio a Pesquisa;
  • Comunicar os resultados de forma clara e compreensível;
  • Criar relatórios, visualizações de dados e gráficos para apresentar as conclusões;
  • Apresentar os resultados em reuniões, adaptando a comunicação para diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes, executivos e outros departamentos.
  • Entre outras atividades relacionadas ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências da computação, Matemática, Engenharia da Computação, ou áreas afins.
  • PowerBI, Grafana
  • SQL, DAX e PowerQuery.
  • Python.
  • Conhecimento ITIL v3 ou v4
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em modelo híbrido.

Horário de trabalho:

  • Seg a Qui de 8:00 as 18:00 e Sex de 8:00 as 17:00

Local de trabalho:

  • CSO – Santa Efigênia em Belo Horizonte/MG

O que oferecemos:

Pesando em seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos o PROGRAMA MAIS SABER – que proporciona descontos, conforme rede conveniada, em instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idiomas.

Para contribuir com sua saúde oferecemos o CLUDE SAÚDE – Programa de serviços como Telemedicina e Telepsicologia oferecendo suporte e recursos para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental.

Somos uma empresa da área de saúde e preocupados em seu bem-estar, oferecemos o PLANO DE SAÚDE e o PLANO ODONTOLÓGICO.

É claro que também temos um SEGURO DE VIDA que cobre as doenças ocupacionais.

Pensando em contribuir com sua refeição na hora do almoço, oferecemos o VALE REFEIÇÃO ou VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO .

Para o seu salário render mais temos a ALLYA – plataforma de descontos.

E para se manter saudável, disponibilizamos o GYMPASS.

No mês do seu aniversário a Oncoclinicas&Co te presenteia com o DAY OFF , um dia de folga sem prejuízo na remuneração.

Venha construir com a gente!

E faça parte do time de pessoas extraordinárias que atuam com a missão de vencer o câncer!

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: PS Systems Engineer
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.


This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
  • Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
  • Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
  • Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
  • Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.


Skills & Experience

  • 3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
  • Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
  • Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.


This is a fully remote position, on a B2B contract basis, paying up to USD20 per hour

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!

title: Programador Ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa: OniLearning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, OniLearning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de OniLearning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações:

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.


Interessado? Envie seu currículo diretamente ao nosso head: Paulo Afonso C. Arruda, pelo e-mail:



A ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!


Paulo Afonso Cardoso de Arruda

Head de Operações e Tecnologia

ONIlearning Technology

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote


Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)
    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)
    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Especialista Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


Oportunidade: Especialista Azure

A PSM Company busca um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para atuar em soluções avançadas na plataforma Microsoft Azure . A posição exige sólida experiência em arquitetura, governança e operação de ambientes corporativos em nuvem, com ênfase em Azure Network , infraestrutura e mecanismos de segurança.


Responsabilidades

  • Estruturar arquiteturas em Azure envolvendo Compute, Network, Storage, Monitoring e Security, garantindo desempenho, confiabilidade e conformidade.
  • Implementar ambientes utilizando VMs, VMSS, AKS, App Services, Functions, pipelines de imagem e automações baseadas em Bicep/Terraform.
  • Projetar topologias de rede complexas, incluindo VNets, Subnets, NSG/ASG, Private Link, Application Gateway, Firewall, Front Door, Load Balancer e conectividade híbrida via VPN ou ExpressRoute.
  • Administrar soluções de armazenamento, contemplando Blob, ADLS Gen2, Azure Files, discos gerenciados, replicação, políticas de ciclo de vida e mecanismos de proteção.
  • Operar ferramentas de observabilidade, configurando logs, métricas, alertas, diagnósticos, KQL e integrações automatizadas.
  • Aplicar práticas de segurança baseadas em Zero Trust, controle de acesso, criptografia, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud e políticas corporativas.
  • Apoiar diretrizes de governança, otimização de custos, nomenclatura, conformidade e padrões arquiteturais.
  • Atuar em integrações com ambientes on-premise, contemplando DNS, DHCP, File Server, clustering e recursos relacionados.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Domínio comprovado em Azure Network (mandatório).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em virtualização, dimensionamento, containers, disponibilidade, continuidade e workloads especializados.
  • Experiência em automação, gestão de configuração, atualização e pipelines de provisionamento.
  • Competência para operar ferramentas de monitoramento e execução de análises avançadas.
  • Sólida compreensão de identidade, políticas, governança e modelos de segurança.
  • Vivência em ambientes híbridos e de grande escala.


Contratação CLT

Contrato híbrido para viagens esporádicas - no mais, a atuação é remota.


O que oferecemos?


· Contratação CLT;

· Vale Refeição;

· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

· Auxílio creche;

· Convênio com Farmácia;

· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

· Seguro de Vida.


O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).


  • Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas.

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Remoto
description:

Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. - Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

title: Operational Specialist
description:
What is Metrobi?

Metrobi is a Techstars-backed startup providing local courier services in 20 major metro areas across the U.S.


About the role

As an operations specialist, you will monitor ongoing delivery routes and communicate with delivery drivers and shippers over the phone and live chat.


Requirements

  • Proficiency in English
  • Being able to work based on the Eastern US time zone (EST)
  • Experience in logistics, courier operations, call center, customer support, or account management
