title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Engenheiro de vendas
description:
Empresa: LoopGlobal
Local: Brasil (Atuação Nacional)
Modelo: Híbrido | Disponibilidade para viagens
Sobre a LoopGlobal
A LoopGlobal é um ecossistema industrial formado por quatro pilares estratégicos:
LoopZero – Engenharia, simulação de processos (MAGMASOFT), desenvolvimento de projetos e soluções avançadas para moldes e injeção.
LoopParts – Comercialização de máquinas e equipamentos para fundição de alumínio, injeção, automação e usinagem.
LoopService – Assistência técnica, start-up, manutenção e otimização de células de injeção.
LoopAcademy – Treinamentos técnicos e capacitação profissional para fundição e injeção de metais.
Nosso propósito é entregar soluções completas para o setor de fundição e injeção de alumínio, combinando tecnologia, engenharia, alta performance e atendimento de excelência.
---
Descrição da Vaga
Buscamos um Engenheiro de Vendas para atuar no setor de injeção de alumínio e automação industrial, com foco em prospectar, desenvolver e gerenciar oportunidades comerciais junto a fundições, injetoras e empresas do segmento metalmecânico.
O profissional será responsável por identificar necessidades técnicas, propor soluções completas (máquinas, células, periféricos, automações, simulações e serviços) e conduzir as negociações até o fechamento.
---
Responsabilidades Principais
Atuação Comercial
Prospectar novos clientes no setor de fundição e injeção de alumínio.
Gerenciar carteira de clientes, mantendo relacionamento contínuo.
Elaborar propostas técnicas e comerciais de máquinas, células completas e soluções de automação.
Realizar apresentações técnicas e reuniões com tomadores de decisão.
Acompanhar indicadores de vendas, margens e projeções comerciais.
Atuação Técnica
Compreender processos de injeção de alumínio (alta pressão).
Interpretar desenhos, projetos e necessidades de células de produção.
Sugerir melhorias técnicas, automações e soluções customizadas.
Interagir com engenharia interna (LoopZero) para validação técnica via MAGMASOFT.
Participar de start-ups, FATs e visitas técnicas quando necessário.
---
Requisitos
Formação
Engenharia Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Produção, Automação ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência
Vivência no setor de injeção de alumínio (HPDC) ou fundição.
Conhecimento em equipamentos como:
Injetoras de alumínio
Fornos
Robôs e automações
Periféricos (dosadoras, termorreguladores, rebarbadores, etc.)
Habilidades Técnicas
Leitura e interpretação de desenho técnico.
Noções de automação industrial (robôs, sensores, manipuladores, células).
Conhecimento de processos: dosagem, ciclo de injeção, extração, resfriamento, metalurgia.
Diferencial: Familiaridade com simulação MAGMASOFT.
Habilidades Comerciais
Comunicação consultiva.
Negociação e relacionamento.
Organização e gestão de pipeline.
Autonomia para visitas e viagens.
---
Benefícios
Remuneração fixa + variável agressiva por performance.
Suporte técnico completo da equipe LoopZero e LoopService.
Treinamentos pela LoopAcademy.
Oportunidade de atuar com marcas de referência em máquinas e tecnologias.
Crescimento estruturado dentro do ecossistema LoopGlobal.
---
Perfil Ideal
Buscamos alguém técnico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados, que domine o ambiente de chão de fábrica e saiba transformar conhecimento técnico em soluções comerciais de alto valor agregado.

title: SAP Coupa  Source to Pay
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Coupa - Source to Pay who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


\"Responsibilities for this role include:

Developer with knowledge Solutions Design for Coupa, Configuration, Documentation, Testing, and Delivery with intelligent automation (Scope includes work among SAP and non-SAP Systems and Applications)

Excellent technical & functional configuration knowledge and demonstrated proficiency for SAP Source to Pay, inclusive of Smart Contract Management, Spend Analytics, Guided Buying, and Collaborative Supply Chain & Procurement Materials Management, Materials Management (Direct and Indirect)

Participate in gathering and documenting overall business requirements. Support all formal documentation of implementation and provide relevant functional inputs to technical team.

Configure and implement Coupa solutions for source to pay processes. Should be able to perform global Coupa configuration, Approval Workflow, Custom field set up for transactions, Chart of account, PO forms, Catalog, Supplier, Item, User setup, Security Roles and Permission as per business requirement.

Experience in Coupa Configuration and data loads in Sourcing, Contracting, Purchasing, invoicing Master data(Supplier, Materials and Accounting data) and Catalog Management.

Experience with Coupa integration and mapping to legacy SAP systems for transactional and master data interface in source to pay.

Create functional specification documents that require development of WRICEF (Workflow Reports Interfaces Conversion Enhancement and Form) objects

Prepare test cases, validate deliverables, and support client testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).

Responsible for solving complex business problems by creating IT solutions in consultation with business partners, architects and other stakeholders\"


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Executive Sales Representative
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Executive Sales Representative


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary: The Executive Sales Representative will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary: The Executive Sales Representative will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software (Back-End) Pleno - Afirmativa PCD
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Missão do cargo:

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.


Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, participando e fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e NodeJS
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
  • Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões altos de performance
  • Observar o desenvolvimento seguro e estar sempre por dentro de atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes relacionados ao desenvolvimento seguro


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Idealizar e construir novas soluções (análise e desenvolvimento);
  • Conceber melhorias nas arquiteturas atuais e de novas soluções;
  • Suportar questões técnicas dos projetos, em suas diversas fases, propondo soluções, indagando caminhos. Sempre de forma crítica e construtiva;
  • Recomendar modificações e melhorias em processos, visando a eficiência das áreas;
  • Solucionar/encaminhar ou ainda escalar impedimentos técnicos apontados pelo time;
  • Contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time, efetuando treinamentos, aconselhamentos (mentoria) e supervisão de pessoas desenvolvedoras menos experientes, sempre que necessário;
  • Contribuir para a produção de padrões e documentação de melhores práticas para a sua equipe e garantir que o desenvolvimento atenda a esses padrões;
  • Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);
  • Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado em linguagem para back-end;
  • Linguagens de programação (Go, NodeJS, SQL);
  • Banco de dados relacionais, não relacionais, colunares/AVRO e elásticos (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Estrutura Cloud (GCP);
  • Pró-eficiência no desenvolvimento de:
  • API Rest;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento e práticas CI/CD;
  • Experiência com práticas de Code Review e Feedback;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe.


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com as perspectiva das boas práticas e requisitos de governança de dados;
  • Teoria e prática em qualidade de dados (Dimensões, Profiling, Data Quality Assessment);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Go;
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em schedulers (Crontab, Jenkins, Airflow, etc);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (SNS, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento de BigQuery, ElasticSearch

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP MM ,Remote in Morumbi-Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Remote, but must be available for occasional visits to Morumbi-SP when requested by the client.

Must Have Skills

'Run functional activities for PTP(Procure to pay) such as Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites, support Developers in code remediation, new developments, run IT and integration testing, support user testing (UAT).


Will participate in SAP Tax Reform Project in a Lifescience Company, running activities for PTP(Procure to pay) in Purchasing, Pricing/Procedure, Tax Code Creation, Support SAP Notes for Tax Reform context and prerequisites.


Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, especially for NFe Inbound knowledge, Pricing and enhancements to supply processes, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects


Good Have to skills

'Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC, Sovos, One Source and Easyway.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

English advanced and Spanish Intermediate.


Key Responsabilities

'As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requirements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

Will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Owner of certain niche processes within broader domain area.

Experience in a Professional LifeScience/Pharma company is an asset.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Node Senior
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Estamos construindo a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?

Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas.

Por isso, buscamos um Super Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Node Senior , dinâmico e experiente, que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Tecnologia e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Irá ajudar a criar e implementar soluções para manter o sistema sempre prático e escalável;
  • Fazer code reviews com atenção e cuidado;
  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar aplicações backend usando Node.js, TypeScript e JavaScript;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para projetar e implementar soluções escaláveis e de alto desempenho;
  • Integrar sistemas com serviços de nuvem (ex: Firebase, AWS) para garantir escalabilidade e confiabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e manter bancos de dados MongoDB, garantindo eficiência e segurança;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de DevOps, automatizando processos e implantando pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Colaborar com outros membros da equipe para garantir a consistência e a qualidade do código;
  • Responder prontamente às necessidades da equipe e do projeto, resolvendo problemas com princípios de programação sólidos.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Node.js;
  • Conhecimento de TypeScript e JavaScript.
  • Experiência em integração com serviços de nuvem (Firebase, AWS, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como Postgres e Mongodb;
  • Saiba escrever testes;
  • Experiência em práticas de DevOps;
  • Compreensão profunda de arquitetura de software orientada a serviços e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Alguma experiência com desenho, construção e otimização de arquitetura serverless;
  • Experiência com Clean Code e/ou Clean Architecture;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com problemas novos e difíceis e de contribuir para bibliotecas conforme necessário.


Será legal se você tiver:

  • Experiência como Tech Lead;
  • Experiência com CI/CD com pipelines;
  • Conhecimento de métodos ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Prática com ferramentas de versionamento como o GIT.


Como é a Cultura Super?

Temos uma cultura de muita confiança, focada em resultados, sem micro gerenciamento, muita autonomia e transparência. Muitos desafios e aprendizados, buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo.


O que oferecemos:

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ;
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil;
  • ⚕Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais;
  • ♀️Wellhub/GymPass: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados;
  • Voucher Kit Escritório: receba um voucher para turbinar o seu espaço de trabalho e garantir seu conforto, comodidade e produtividade;
  • Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar;
  • Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus;

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
TITAN is a no-code, web-based, fast paced growing startup within the Salesforce ecosystem. Our platform allows for seamless form creation, data collection, and workflow automation, all with no coding required. We are looking to hire Customer Success Managers to join our growing Customer Success team in North America.


As a Customer Success Manager , you'll manage client onboarding, expansions, and renewals while leveraging technical expertise with a strategic business mindset to build strong customer relationships and identify growth opportunities. Join our innovative CS team to drive success and collaborate with Sales, Product, Solutions, and Support teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, ensuring seamless onboarding, training, and adoption.
  • Lead discovery meetings with key users and stakeholders from customers and partners to position Titan as a core system and focus on maximizing its value.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to drive engagement and long-term success.
  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities by aligning product capabilities with customer needs.
  • Analyze customer usage data to proactively address risks and drive retention strategies.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address issues to drive customer satisfaction and retention.


Requirements:

  • 2-4 years of proven experience as a Customer Success Manager or Technical Account Manager in a SaaS company (must ).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer-facing abilities, including a willingness to meet clients onsite and lead business discussions.
  • Experience in identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and working closely with Sales.
  • Hands-on experience with onboarding and implementation processes of Salesforce or other CRMs - a must.
  • A can-do approach with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work remotely across EST/PST time zones.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business or equivalent experience.


Why Join TITAN?:

  • Work with a dynamic and innovative team in a fast-growing SaaS startup
  • Collaborate with industry-leading clients and gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies
  • Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and a healthy work-life balance
  • Competitive compensation package and opportunities for professional growth and development

title: Desenvolvedor FullStack Java & React Sr (Home Office)
description:
A Insightful Consulting é uma empresa de tecnologia que transforma ideias em soluções digitais até 10x mais rápido com o poder do low-code Mendix da Siemens. Ajudamos empresas a acelerar sua jornada de inovação, unindo agilidade, escalabilidade e governança em um só ambiente.


Resumo da oportunidade

Atuação alocada em cliente do setor de Instituto de Ciência e Tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e soluções que promovem relações mais éticas, sustentáveis e atentas a riscos e governança. Como pessoa desenvolvedora Java, você contribuirá na criação e evolução de aplicativos web e serviços, do desenho à implantação, em um ambiente 100% remoto e colaborativo.

O foco é construir software robusto com Java e Spring, integrar sistemas via APIs REST e aplicar boas práticas de engenharia, trabalhando em parceria com áreas de produto e, quando necessário, com clientes para traduzir requisitos em soluções técnicas eficazes.


Responsabilidades do dia a dia

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos web multiusuário (back-end e front-end), com possibilidade de implantação em nuvem.
  • Conduzir atividades em todas as fases do ciclo de desenvolvimento e implantação, em metodologias ágeis ou tradicionais.
  • Participar da definição de soluções técnicas a partir de requisitos de negócio, colaborando com produto e clientes.
  • Escrever código bem projetado, testável, eficiente, confiável e seguro, aderente à arquitetura de referência.
  • Projetar e executar testes unitários e de integração.
  • Aplicar conceitos de reúso e zelar pela documentação do código.
  • Versionar e revisar mudanças continuamente, mantendo rastreabilidade.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em Java (8/17 ou superior) e ecossistema Spring (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data).
  • Experiência em front-end: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, jQuery e React.
  • Sólida experiência em APIs REST, autenticação com JWT e integração entre sistemas.
  • Experiência em Hibernate/JPA e bancos SQL (modelagem e otimização).
  • Experiência em AWS (serviços de nuvem), Docker (containers) e Git (versionamento).
  • Metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum.


Habilidades:

  • Projetar serviços e aplicações web escaláveis, observáveis e fáceis de manter.
  • Modelar dados e camadas de persistência com foco em desempenho e consistência.
  • Implementar integrações REST seguras e resilientes.
  • Escrever testes unitários e de integração, automatizando rotinas-chave.
  • Documentar soluções e apoiar revisões técnicas (code review).


Atitudes:

  • Comunicação clara com time, produto e stakeholders.
  • Colaboração e disponibilidade para discutir alternativas técnicas.
  • Organização e foco em qualidade de entrega.
  • Autonomia, responsabilidade pelo código e melhoria contínua.


Adicionais:

  • Graduação completa em TI (ex.: Desenvolvimento de Software, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas).


Diferenciais (opcional):

  • Pós-graduação em áreas de tecnologia.
  • Experiência com NoSQL.
  • Experiência em projetos de integração usando OpenAI, Gemini e/ou Copilot.
  • Vivência com assistentes de programação baseadas em IA.


Condições da vaga

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ .
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto .

title: MSP Delivery Specialist (Bilingual English | Portuguese)
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.


Summary

Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.


Job Description

  • Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
  • Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
  • Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
  • Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
  • Utilize and provide training on MSP tool such as Beeline and applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in MSP operations, or contingent workforce management .
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience with Beeline
  • Bilingual Competency across English and Portuguese
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly.
  • Proven success in a client-facing, fast-paced, and service-oriented environment.
  • Self-starter who can work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with a solution-driven mindset.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.


Compensation and Benefits Disclosure

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:
Position Overview


The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.


Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.


Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.


Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.


Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.


Qualifications


Required

  • 7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
  • 3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.


Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: .Net AWS Developer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior .NET Developer with AWS experience to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services with over 300,000 team members in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the quick serve restaurants industry.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil .


Working hours: Pacific Time Zone . You will be required to follow the client's time zone.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Responsibilities :

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable applications using .NET in an AWS environment, and related technologies.
  • Develop and maintain back-end applications using ASP.NET, Web APIs, etc.
  • Integrate third-party services and APIs into internal applications
  • Ensure high-quality code by writing automated tests, performing code reviews, and adhering to best practices


Requirements:

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • Strong understanding of .NET Core and Web APIs , along with knowledge of AWS.
  • Proficient in C#, with experience building backend services (.NET framework)
  • Hands on experience in AWS environments (Azure is a plus)
  • The client expects the developer to have a very good understanding of AWS features and tools such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, EKS, Kubernetes , etc.
  • Experience supporting an integration and transformation platforms between internal systems and external vendor systems, especially those involving complex business logic.
  • Azure : Having knowledge in this area would be a bonus
  • Understanding of the QSR (fast food) industry : This is also considered a plus.
  • Good Understanding of OAuth and webhooks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience of working in a Agile environment

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer (Webflow + WordPress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.



What You’ll Do


  • Design and develop responsive, visually engaging websites in Webflow and WordPress .
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Translate approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or WordPress.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Ensure all designs follow UX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress .
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds .
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.



Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.



Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST , Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
QAT Global – 100% Remote (Brazil Only – CLT hire)

QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is seeking highly-skilled Java Full-Stack Developers with strong English communication skills to join our global engineering team. You will collaborate directly with our US-based customer and work with distributed development teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


About the Role


As a Java Full-Stack Developer, you will be responsible for building mission-critical backend services and front-end components that support a large-scale financial platform. You will work across domains involving profiles, billing, ledger, invoicing, and payment flows, contributing to both core business logic and customer-facing UI experiences.

This role requires strong expertise in modern full-stack engineering combined with practical experience using AI-assisted development workflows , LLMs, and prompt engineering to accelerate delivery while maintaining high quality.


Responsibilities

title: Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Credit Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical, organized, and hands-on professional with strong leadership skills to coordinate the areas of Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit . This is a strategic position with a structured career path toward a Finance Manager role within up to 18 months , based on performance.

Key Responsibilities

Treasury

  • Prepare and monitor daily, weekly, and projected cash flow;
  • Manage bank accounts, balances, reconciliations, and financial investments;
  • Plan fund transfers between SPVs (SPEs) and partners;
  • Support Controllership with monthly close and cash flow projections;
  • Ensure banking security, proper segregation of duties, and approval levels.

Accounts Payable

  • Coordinate the full payment cycle (review, approval, and execution);
  • Ensure accurate posting of invoices, tax withholdings, and cost centers;
  • Implement and maintain payment policies;
  • Control due dates for contracts, insurance policies, and recurring expenses;
  • Monitor advances, corporate credit cards, and payment exceptions;
  • Support financial automation initiatives and accounting integration.

Accounts Receivable & Collections

  • Coordinate billing (rent, charges, fees, and services);
  • Monitor delinquency, aging reports, collections, and postings in the ERP;
  • Implement preventive and corrective collection policies;
  • Support negotiations with customers and legal teams when required;
  • Develop management reports by property/project.

Credit

  • Implement and continuously review the company’s credit policy;
  • Perform customer financial and credit analysis;
  • Classify customers according to risk levels;
  • Monitor delinquency indicators and credit performance;
  • Train commercial and operational teams on credit rules and processes.

Management & Strategy

  • Develop financial dashboards and performance indicators;
  • Lead continuous improvement and automation projects;
  • Act as the financial interface with partners, funds, and investors;
  • Conduct performance evaluations, develop successors, and build future leaders;
  • Act strategically alongside Controllership and Executive Management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or related fields;
  • Solid experience in Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Credit;
  • Experience working with financial ERP systems;
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills;
  • Leadership profile with autonomy and strategic mindset;
  • English proficiency is a plus (reading and speaking).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the real estate sector;
  • Experience managing financial flows between SPVs (SPEs);
  • Proven experience implementing financial automation.

What We Offer

  • Clear and structured career path toward a Finance Manager position;
  • Strong technical and strategic development environment;
  • Direct exposure to business financial decision-making.

title: Software Developer - Java/Golang
description:
• Project Description:

Work on backend components for enterprise-scale headend applications in the media domain. You will develop and maintain cloud-based microservices supporting high-volume workflows.


  • Responsibilities:

- Implement backend services using Java and Golang.

- Develop APIs and integrate event-driven systems.

- Participate in Agile development and CI/CD processes.

- Support operational tasks and troubleshoot issues.


Mandatory Skills Description:

- Experience in Java and Golang development.

- Knowledge of microservices architecture and API design.

- Familiarity with AWS services (Lambda, S3).

- Basic understanding of Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.

- Exposure to SQL/NoSQL databases.

-English: C1 Advanced

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Position : Staff Software Engineer

Location: Remote - working EST time zone

Duration: 12-month contract + extensions


About the Role:

We are seeking a Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership and mentorship to our engineering team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in Java development, including Spring Boot and Microservices architecture, and a proven track record of building robust, efficient solutions with PIM and Event Streaming experience. This role requires a strong technical foundation, leadership capabilities, a passion for innovation, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and manage stakeholder relationships to deliver high-quality software. This is an individual contributor role - but will be providing technical leadership in terms of strategy, mentorship, etc.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Senior Engineer
  • 9+ years of experience in Java development and working in Spring Boot frameworks.
  • 1-2+ years of experience working a retail environment
  • Experience working with PIM platforms
  • Experience building Microservices using Spring frameworks and deploying to cloud environments such as GCP/AWS/Azure in an agile environment.
  • Hands-on experience in API development such as RESTFUL/ SOAP web services.
  • Working knowledge of database and storage such as Oracle, Postgresql, MongoDB, or Redis, etc.
  • Experience in event driven/message-oriented middleware such as IBM MQ, Kafka, RabbitMQ etc.
  • Demonstrated ability in building and leading technical teams, with or without direct reports.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working in a developer-centric, startup-like environment.


Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience in leading engineering projects and integrating PIM platforms such as Akeneo.

title: Delivery Coordinator
description:
Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Delivery Coordinator para liderar a execução de projetos de implantação de soluções AWS em clientes dos EUA. A posição exige experiência sólida em gestão de projetos de escopo fechado e híbrido, além de forte habilidade de comunicação em inglês (nível C1), para interação com stakeholders internacionais.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos complexos de curta duração (em média 3 meses), incluindo assessments, POCs e MVPs.
  • Conduzir implantações de projetos AWS em clientes dos EUA.
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento, motivação e produtividade.
  • Acompanhar e controlar cronogramas, escopo, riscos e entregas.
  • Realizar acompanhamento e controle financeiro dos projetos, garantindo saúde orçamentária e rentabilidade.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com stakeholders e clientes, assegurando qualidade e satisfação nas entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de gestão de projetos (de preferência com certificação PMP).


Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente (nível C1) – imprescindível.
  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de projetos complexos, preferencialmente de tecnologia e cloud.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação de soluções AWS é um diferencial relevante.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes e coordenação de recursos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de projetos híbridas (ágil e waterfall).
  • Certificação PMP (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade de organização, comunicação e resolução de problemas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em consultorias de tecnologia.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos internacionais.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Somos mais do que um software financeiro.


A Kamino é a plataforma de gestão financeira mais completa para empresas de serviços de médio porte no Brasil . Nosso grande diferencial está em unir um software que automatiza operações financeiras (contas a pagar, contas a receber e conciliação) à integração nativa de contas bancárias e cartão corporativo de crédito, tudo em uma única plataforma. Além disso, conecta-se de forma fluida aos principais bancos e ERPs locais .


O resultado é mais eficiência, controle e visibilidade , gerando economias significativas de tempo e custos para os clientes da Kamino.


Sobre o desafio


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Full Stack Developer para se juntar ao nosso time de tecnologia na Kamino e ajudar a construir as soluções que sustentam o crescimento dos nossos produtos.


Você busca um ambiente no qual fará parte de inovações desde o #Dia1 ?

Quer ter opções de ações e fazer parte de uma startup bem capitalizada que está pronta para acelerar?

Se a resposta for sim , continue acompanhando os requisitos que fazem sentido para essa oportunidade.


️ O que esperamos de você nesta kaminhada:


  • Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora para atuar no nosso time de engenharia, contribuindo com o desenvolvimento de produtos robustos, escaláveis e de alta qualidade. Aqui na Kamino, você terá liberdade e autonomia para propor soluções, colaborar com diferentes áreas e evoluir sua carreira com protagonismo.

title: ServiceNow Administrator/Developer (Inglês Fluente)
description:
#VAGA REMOTA para Administrador/Desenvolvedor ServiceNow Sênior (Inglês Fluente)


Fuso de trabalho: EST (Eastern Time)

Idioma: Inglês fluente obrigatório!


A Stefanini LATAM está buscando um Senior ServiceNow Administrator / Developer para atuar em um projeto internacional no setor de manufatura e mineração global. Esta é uma oportunidade 100% remota, em modelo contractor (PJ via Deel) , para profissionais com sólida experiência em administração, desenvolvimento e integração da plataforma ServiceNow.



Responsabilidades:


  • Administrar, configurar e manter a plataforma ServiceNow, garantindo desempenho, estabilidade e usabilidade.
  • Gerenciar acessos, workflows, UI Policies, Flow Designer e configurações gerais da plataforma.
  • Otimizar e configurar o Service Operations Workspace para suportar operações de Service Desk.
  • Atuar com equipes multifuncionais para levantamento de requisitos e implementação de melhorias.

  • Manter e evoluir integrações com ferramentas de monitoramento, CMDB, HR systems, cloud platforms, entre outras.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica (arquitetura, processos, integrações e procedimentos).
  • Apoiar upgrades, novas implementações e governança da plataforma conforme práticas ITIL.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Principais responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver e manter a lógica de negócios de aplicações complexas, utilizando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e as tecnologias mais recentes.

- Desenvolver e implementar soluções robustas e escaláveis utilizando Java e seus principais frameworks.

- Identificar pontos de melhoria no código e uso eficiente dos componentes de arquitetura.

- Realizar troubleshooting de sistemas.

- Garantir a qualidade do código através de testes unitários e de integração.

- Trabalhar em equipe, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e stakeholders.

- Realizar a manutenção e otimização de sistemas existentes.

- Acompanhar as últimas tendências e tecnologias do mercado


Requisitos obrigatórios:

- JAVA/J2EE

- Apache Maven

- Eureka

- AWS Secret Manager

- Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure, GCP)

- Testes unitários componentes e classes (TDD) - Karma e Junit

- Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD)

- Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform

- Desenevolvimento Backend com SPRING BOOT

- Desenevolvimento de API's, JAVA EE, SPRING WEB, SPRING DATA, SPRING SECURITY

- Banco de Dados (SQL, MYSQL, POSTGRESQL)

- API ( Postman)

- API Gateway (Spring Cloud)

- API (REST, RESTFUL, WEBSOCKET, SOAP, WEBHOOK, GRAPHQL)


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
Position Summary

We are looking for a Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist to join a fast-growing real estate startup in the U.S. This is a hybrid role that combines helpdesk support, HubSpot operations, outbound sales assistance, and light marketing support.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing support tickets, excellent communication skills, deep familiarity with HubSpot, and the ability to multitask across customer support, RevOps, and sales processes in a fast-paced startup environment.


Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Helpdesk (40–50%)

  • Serve as the primary responder for inbound support tickets from users.
  • Monitor, triage, and resolve issues through HubSpot Service Hub.
  • Maintain strong response/resolution times with empathetic, professional communication.
  • Document common issues and build internal resources or playbooks.


HubSpot Operations & Administration (20–25%)

  • Manage and optimize workflows, pipelines, automations, and ticket management across HubSpot.
  • Maintain data accuracy for contacts, deals, and support tickets.
  • Support setup and QA of new sequences, processes, and automation in HubSpot.
  • Pull basic reports on sales activity, ticket volume, and marketing performance.


Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting (20–25%)

  • Execute outbound email campaigns and sequences targeting prospects such as real estate agents or brokers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads following defined playbooks.
  • Set calls and demos for the sales team.
  • Track all activities and updates inside HubSpot.


Marketing Support (5–10%)

  • Assist with email marketing campaigns, list building, and segmentation.
  • Support basic digital marketing tasks as needed.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of customer support or helpdesk experience (B2B SaaS experience preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
  • Service/Operations Hub (tickets, workflows, automation)
  • Sales Hub (pipelines, deals, sequences, tasks)
  • Proven success managing support tickets as a core responsibility.
  • Experience supporting outbound sales workflows, sequences, and appointment setting.
  • Familiarity with email marketing or digital campaign support.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with shifting demands.
  • Availability to work 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM MST .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in real estate or PropTech industries.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, ClickUp, and Canva.
  • Experience building support documentation, macros, or knowledge base articles.
  • Track record of improving support metrics or boosting outbound meeting conversions.


What We Offer

  • Fully Remote Position! Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and skill development.
  • Take Your Local Holidays: We respect your cultural and personal commitments.
  • Impact: Join a mission-driven U.S. startup where your work directly enhances customer experience and revenue operations.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

title: Technical Lead Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Technical Lead Developer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

kills: B2B domain expertise, Salesforce, strong communication, process improvement

JD:

  • Act as the primary SPOC , coordinating resources and managing priorities across teams.
  • Drive service reviews, escalate issues, and ensure timely resolution for critical business processes.
  • Suggest and implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and governance.
  • Analyze KPIs and reporting metrics to identify trends and recommend corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align technology solutions with business objectives and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Expertise in Salesforce Configurations using Workflows, Process builders, Flows, Roles, Enterprise Territory Management, Security Controls, Reports and Dashboards and Sharing rules.
  • Experience in Administration, Configuration, Implementation and experience with Salesforce platform.
  • Experience in Salesforce Customization, Security Access, Workflow Approvals, Data Validation, data utilities.
  • Expertise in SFDC Development using Apex Language, Visual Force pages, Classes, Controllers, Triggers, Indexes, Web Services, Components, Tabs, Apex Web services, Custom Objects, Reports, Analytic Snapshots and Dashboards, Profiles, Creating Roles, Page Layouts, Org - Wide default, Sharing rules, Work Flows
  • Experience in Sales Cloud, Field Service and CPQ, Ant Migration tool, Standard and custom controllers, Data Loader, Force.com, Eclipse IDE Plug-in, VS Code, Work Flow-Approval, Custom objects, Custom tabs, Email service, Html, Web-service (REST and SOAP)
  • Experience in debugging the code for troubleshooting the issues


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief
